evals.prompt: Create a project-local Atlas verifier that a fresh agent can execute. The repo has a documented public CLI export, uses Codex and Claude Code, and sessions often begin outside the repository. Product code is read-only.
evals.expected_output: Creates one canonical project-level English skill with matched OpenAI metadata and grounded discovery, runs a mapped path, retains proof and distinguishes map coverage from live verification.
expectations: Keeps product know-how in the project
Uses existing repo commands and compatible discovery conventions
Produces English instructions and aligned UI metadata
Runs generated instructions and preserves proof

evals.prompt: A verification run fails because the verifier calls --source, while the current CLI and README require --input. Repair only the encountered verifier path.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the verifier-owned recipe using source and re-drives the real command.
expectations: Executes changed instructions before claiming repair

evals.prompt: The documented export command works and returns zero, but the real CSV loses Unicode titles. Source and intended product behavior require preserving titles. Maintain the verifier if justified; product fixes are outside this task.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the failing expectation and reports a product failure rather than weakening verification.
expectations: Checks actual output beyond exit status
Keeps product fixes in the product task
Does not treat failure alone as verifier drift

evals.prompt: The verifier recipe matches current source, the real run passes, and no new reusable prerequisite or recipe drift was found. Reassess maintenance after this run.
evals.expected_output: Leaves verifier files unchanged and reports the scoped result.
expectations: Clean run with no grounded gap is a no-op
Does not expand into a full audit

evals.prompt: A run lacks entitlement and cannot export. The source and canonical instructions already document the required access. This task cannot grant access. Check for justified maintenance.
evals.expected_output: Retains the coverage gap and avoids encoding temporary access loss as product behavior.
expectations: Requires source-backed workflow gaps for edits
A proven omitted readiness check may be added without claiming behavior passed

evals.prompt: The cleanup recipe targets a process name, but this run only owns one recorded process and the app is borrowed. The ownership contract and runtime evidence identify the mismatch.
evals.expected_output: Repairs the owned cleanup recipe and verifies it preserves borrowed resources and evidence.
expectations: Treats ownership/cleanup drift as a maintenance trigger

evals.prompt: Audit the complete feature map. No features are missing, but one existing feature points at a removed route and stale success criterion; source and live behavior document the replacement.
evals.expected_output: Checks existing mapped paths as well as missing features and proves corrections within the audit scope.
expectations: Reconciles existing map with current source
Checks unmapped features during full audit

evals.prompt: An ordinary feature task already has a working verifier. Verify only the current feature; no authoring or workflow drift is present.
evals.expected_output: Uses the project verifier without initiating Build Verifier authoring or maintenance.
